import pytest
from clinical_chart_parser import clinical_chart_parser_processor

def test_clinical_chart_parser_processor_success():
    sample_data = {"items": [{"id": 101, "value": "Test Payload A"}, {"id": 102, "value": "Test Payload B"}]}
    res = clinical_chart_parser_processor(sample_data)
    assert res["status"] == "SUCCESS"
    assert res["processed_count"] == 2
    assert res["module"] == "clinical_chart_parser"

def test_clinical_chart_parser_processor_empty():
    res = clinical_chart_parser_processor({})
    assert res["status"] == "EMPTY_INPUT"
    assert res["processed_count"] == 0
